iCarly: Da Gibby
programme.desc: Gibby corona un sogno che aveva fin da quando era bambino: aprire un ristorante, e lo fa nel seminterrato della scuola.

programme.title: iCarly: Pesce d'aprile
programme.desc: Carly e Spencer hanno ricevuto un avviso di sfratto e devono lasciare la loro casa nel giro di due ore. Insieme a Freddie e Sam si mettono a ricordare insieme i bei vecchi tempi passati.

programme.title: iCarly: Il nuovo commesso
programme.desc: Freddie ottiene un lavoro al Pera Store e dovrà vedersela non solo con i clienti noiosi e indecisi, ma anche con la sua nuova collega, Sam, che viene assunta e promossa suo responsabile.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween a sorpresa
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie decidono di inventare una festa che cada a metà tra due Halloween e la chiamano Metàlloween.

programme.title: iCarly: Chip, il terribile
programme.desc: Nel palazzo in cui vivono Carly e Spencer abita anche un ragazzino di nome Chuck che tormenta Spencer con scherzi cattivissimi.

programme.title: iCarly: I due "banditi"
programme.desc: Freddie e Gibby fingono di avere un complesso musicale per far colpo su due ragazze incontrate al Groovy Smoothy. Sam li mette nei guai organizzando loro un concerto.

programme.title: iCarly: Missione a Las Vegas
programme.desc: Grazie al suo avvocato, Sam viene a sapere che sua madre è in stato d'arresto a Las Vegas. Nonostante il rapporto non buono che ha con lei, Sam vorrebbe andare in Nevada per tirarla fuori.

programme.title: iCarly: Amicizie pericolose
programme.desc: Sam incontra Dana, una sua ex compagna di riformatorio appena uscita, che la invita a una festa in cui i ragazzi possono distruggere tutto!

programme.title: iCarly: Scandalo a New York parte 1
programme.desc: Carly e i suoi amici vengono invitati a New York nello show di Jimmy Fallon, lo show è in diretta e i quattro ne combinano delle belle!

programme.title: iCarly: Scandalo a New York parte 2
programme.desc: Dopo quello che è successo da Jimmy Fallon il garante delle comunicazioni impone ai ragazzi di iCarly di pagare un'ammenda salatissima, pena la chiusura definitiva del loro web show.

programme.title: iCarly: Nuovi amici per Spencer
programme.desc: Carly vorrebbe andare alla tradizionale festa "padri-figlie" che si tiene in una base militare di Seattle, dove suo padre la portava sempre quand'era una bambina.

programme.title: iCarly: Un ladro insospettabile
programme.desc: Sam non riesce più a trovare il suo laptop. Dopo aver messo a ferro e fuoco la casa di Carly, quella di Freddie e il Groovy Smoothy, conclude che deve esserle stato rubato. Chi sarà stato?

programme.title: iCarly: iGoodbye - Parte 1
programme.desc: Carly vorrebbe andare alla tradizionale festa "padri-figlie" che si tiene in una base militare di Seattle, dove suo padre la portava sempre quand'era una bambina...

programme.title: iCarly: iGoodbye - Parte 2
programme.desc: Carly è terribilmente delusa dalla piega che hanno preso gli eventi. Freddie e Gibby si offrono di accompagnarla alla festa ma lei rifiuta, inconsolabile. Proprio in quel momento però...

programme.title: iCarly: iPilot
programme.desc: Carly si occupa dello show della scuola. Subito si diffonde una grande clamore. Così Carly e i suoi amici decidono di creare uno show di intrattenimento settimanale.

programme.title: iCarly: Io amo Jake
programme.desc: Carly è eccitata per il fatto che Jake, il ragazzo di cui è innamorata, abbia acconsentito a cantare all'interno del loro webcast.

programme.title: iCarly: Io voglio più visitatori
programme.desc: Carly e Sam sfidano Freddie e Spencer in una gara su chi riesce ad attrarre il maggior numero di spettatori nello show. Tutti impazziscono quando i ragazzi mettono in atto i loro piani.

programme.title: iCarly: Io e Nevel
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie vorrebbero che il loro show fosse recensito. Carly rischia di ricevere una cattiva pubblicità quando insulta il supponente ragazzino undicenne che gestisce un popolare sito che dà i voti ai siti web.

programme.title: iCarly: Voglio stare con Spencer
programme.desc: Il nonno di Carly arriva per una visita ma è colpito dall'insolito comportamento di Spencer, cosicchè contesta la capacità di Spencer di sentirsi responsabile. Carly deve convincerlo che Spencer è in grado di fare il custode.

programme.title: iCarly: Intrappolati in casa Briggs
programme.desc: Il tema per il prossimo webcast di iCarly è capire che cosa significa fare gli insegnanti al di fuori della scuola. Quando Carly e Freddie seguono la signora Briggs, essi rimangono bloccati dentro la sua casa.

programme.title: iCarly: Un record da battere
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie vogliono battere il precedente record del mondo della più lunga trasmissione web in diretta, che è di poco più di 24 ore. L'impresa si rivela tutt'altro che facile.

programme.title: iCarly: Un appuntamento per Freddy
programme.desc: Valerie, una ragazza dalla scuola, mostra interesse per Freddie, così i due si fidanzano. La ragazza cerca di strappare via Freddie da iCarly per realizzare un suo webcast e cosìCerca anche di reclutare Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: L'arte nel cuore
programme.desc: Spencer si deprime e smette di interessarsi di arte dopo che il suo idolo critica il suo lavoro. Carly cerca di alleviare la sua delusione mostrando alcune delle sculture di Spencer nello show.

programme.title: iCarly: Io sono la vostra più grande fan
programme.sub-title: Io sono la vostra più grande fan
programme.desc: Carly invita il suo più grande fan ad assistere a una registrazione live di iCarly, ma la ragazza è così ossessionata che non riescono a sbarazzarsi di lei.

programme.title: iCarly: Pulcini da salvare
programme.desc: Carly e Sam devono fare una ricerca scolastica e scelgono di far schiudere in casa delle uova. L'argomento sembra interessante e le ragazze decidono anche di mostrare su iCarly l'intero processo che porterà alla nascita dei pulcini.

programme.title: iCarly: Il litigio
programme.desc: Carly regala a Sam una maglietta che ha creato apposta per lei, con il logo di iCarly e le loro facce sopra. Sam, per ricambiare, vorrebbe regalarle i biglietti per il concerto di un gruppo.

programme.title: iCarly: Il sogno di ballare
programme.desc: Per i loro balletti, Carly e Sam prendono ispirazione dai video inviati dai fans del loro web show. Carly si divincola in modo maldestro in sogno con il suo affascinante partner.

programme.title: iCarly: La notte di Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam e Freddie trasmettono il loro webcast di Halloween da un appartamento che si dice essere abitato dai fantasmi.

programme.title: iCarly: Il sabotaggio
programme.desc: I Plain White T's devono suonare ad iCarly, ma Nevel progetta di sabotare l'evento facendo hackeraggio sul sito.

programme.title: iCarly: La punizione
programme.desc: Sam viene punita dal professor Horward, il più tremendo di tutto l'istituto, ed è costretta a tornare la sera a scuola, proprio il giorno in cui deve andare in onda la 50esima puntata di ICarly.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La perfida insegnante
programme.desc: Drake vorrebbe lasciare Kelly, la ragazza con cui sta uscendo, ma scopre che è la figlia della sua professoressa d’inglese che è pronta a vendicarsi con il ragazzo se lui farà soffrire la sua bambina.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La fan numero uno
programme.desc: Un’amichetta di Megan che si considera la fan numero uno di Drake. Ma dopo avergli chiesto l’autografo, la ragazzina comincia a tempestare di attenzioni il giovane che finisce per perdere la pazienza.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La griglia di Gary
programme.desc: Drake e Josh vengono ingaggiati da due individui per vendere griglie dotate di lettore mp3 incorporato. I due ragazzi si rivelano abili venditori ma vengono interrotti dalla polizia che li arresta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Drew & Jerry
programme.desc: Drake dice al fratello che vorrebbe avere più tempo da trascorre da solo e Josh lo accontenta trovandosi un nuovo amico: Drew. Che, guarda a caso, è praticamente una copia di Drake.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Presunto colpevole
programme.desc: All'insegnante di inglese, la signora Hayfer, fanno ritrovare l’auto parcheggiata in mezzo all'aula. La colpa ricade subito sul povero Drake anche perché nel bagagliaio viene trovata la sua giacca.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Avventura in elicottero
programme.desc: Drake vince una lezione di paracadutismo acrobatico dall’elicottero e nonostante il parere contrario dei genitori decide di provare l’ebbrezza di un lancio...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La gara di ballo
programme.desc: Durante una festa un po’ smorta, Josh tira fuori le sue doti da balerino per animarla. Josh riscuote molto successo e viene incoraggiato dai presenti a partecipare ad una gara di ballo televisiva.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Gamberi giganti - 1a parte
programme.desc: Drake ingaggia Josh come manager e dopo alcuni provini riesce a firmare un contratto. È l’inizio di un mucchio di guai...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Gamberi giganti - 2a parte
programme.desc: Josh decide di aiutare Drake ma quello che fa è illegale e potrebbe costare a Drake la prigione e una multa salatissima...

programme.title: True Jackson: Pilot
programme.desc: True Jackson, quindici anni, viene assunta dal designer Max Madigan che la nota mentre vende panini scaduti all'interno del distretto della moda e la nomina Vice Presidente della linea giovanile.

programme.title: True Jackson: True Conquista L'islanda
programme.desc: Sta per arrivare il proprietario della più grande catena di negozi di abbigliamento d'Islanda e Max chiede ad Amanda e True di creare un modello in grado di accaparrarsi il cliente.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Licenziamento Di Lulu
programme.desc: Lulu, la migliore amica di True, nel ruolo di assistente, ne combina di tutti i colori mettendo a repentaglio la sua e la reputazione di True, al punto che Max le ordina di licenziarla.

programme.title: True Jackson: Una Baby Sitter Per Dakota
programme.desc: La top model quindicenne Dakota North viene scelta come testimonial della linea di moda autunnale della Mad Style e True viene incaricata di farle compagnia.

programme.title: True Jackson: Chi Lo Dice Ad Amanda?
programme.desc: Ryan scopre che il fidanzato di Amanda, Chad, a pranzo ha appuntamento con un'altra. Decide di seguirlo insieme a True.

programme.title: True Jackson: L'organizzatrice Di Incontri
programme.desc: True consegna un misterioso pacco, proveniente da Parigi, al signor Madigan. La consegna del pacco rende il signor Madigan molto triste.

programme.title: True Jackson: Ritorno Al Liceo
programme.desc: Amanda viene invitata a una festa dei vecchi compagni di liceo e pensa di approfittarne per saldare un vecchio conto rimasto in sospeso con la ex compagna Emily.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Prototipo
programme.desc: Lulu è stata invitata ad un ballo all'Accademia delle Belle Arti, e chiede a True se può disegnarle un abito per quell'evento.

programme.title: True Jackson: Ryan Su Rotelle
programme.desc: True ha il compito di disegnare la linea skate firmata da Ryan Sheckler, famoso campione. Ryan, suo omonimo, impazzisce all'idea, ma non apprezza i modelli creati da True.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Tappeto Rosso
programme.desc: L'attrice Jenna Lutrell vuole un abito da sera da indossare ad una serata vip, ed è True a disegnarglielo. Ma Jenna richiede continue modifiche e l'abito originale si trasforma in tutt'altra cosa...

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Rivale
programme.desc: Negli anni '80 il signor Madigan, alla Mad Style, era socio con Simon Cristini, ma la loro collaborazione finì a causa dell'eterna, distruttiva, competizione tra i due.

programme.title: True Jackson: Spese Folli
programme.desc: Durante un pranzo dei dirigenti della Mad Style, True scopre che anche lei, come tutti i quadri, ha in dotazione una carta di credito aziendale per le spese inerenti il lavoro.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Ritiro Aziendale
programme.desc: È la giornata annuale del ritiro aziendale a Mad Style, e il signor Madigan pensa, anziché fare un viaggio come al solito, di portare un luogo esotico all'interno dell'azienda.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Ballo Dell'ultimo Minuto
programme.desc: True riceve due biglietti per un ballo, e non sa chi dei suoi due amici portare con se', Lulu o Ryan. Ma anche Billy ha due biglietti e dice di voler invitare una ragazza che lavora alla Mad Style.

programme.title: True Jackson: La Spia
programme.desc: Max è appena tornato da un viaggio in Africa e ha portato con sé una nuova scoperta segreta: un tessuto eco compatibile ricavato dalla corteccia dell'albero Matuba.

programme.title: True Jackson: Amanda Assume Una Pink
programme.desc: Alla Mad Style si presentano le Pink, tre ragazze terribili che frequentano la stessa scuola di True. La ragazza è terrorizzata soprattutto da una di loro, Pinky e quando Amanda lo scopre, la assume.

programme.title: True Jackson: La Settimana Della Moda
programme.desc: È la "settimana della moda", uno dei più grandi eventi dell'anno a New York, e, con sorpresa di tutti, questa volta Mad Style è stata scartata dalle selezioni.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Manichino Di Max
programme.desc: La Mad Style deve presentare la nuova linea maschile per l'autunno e Max è alla ricerca di un'idea per promuovere il lancio.

programme.title: True Jackson: Scambio Di Ruoli
programme.desc: True lancia l'idea di organizzare uno "scambio-day" perché tutti comprendano il lavoro dei colleghi all'interno della Mad Style. Il destino le affida il ruolo di grande capo.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Matrimonio
programme.desc: È una data storica a Mad Style: è il giorno del matrimonio tra Doris e Max. Le attività ordinarie della casa di moda vengono sospese e tutti si dedicano ai preparativi per il grande evento.

programme.title: True Jackson: Tutti A Casa Di Mikey J
programme.sub-title: Tutti A Casa Di Mikey J
programme.desc: True ha un'importante presentazione da organizzare ma Ryan e Lulu ci tengono a ricordarle che ha promesso di partecipare alla festa di Mikey J, il fidanzatino dell'amica.

programme.title: Die Kirche bleibt im Dorf
programme.desc: Oma Anni - Oma Anni, vollauf damit beschäftigt, die Familie Häberle zusammenzuhalten, bereitet energisch die Taufe des kleinen Thaddäus vor, auch gegen den Willen von Sohn Gottfried und Enkelin Maria. Nur dem Pfarrer vertraut sie ihre Sorge an, dass es sich bei dem Kleinen um ein Unterrieslinger Kuckuckskind handeln könnte - das natürlich umso dringlicher getauft werden muss. Ausgerechnet Klara steht an ihrer Seite, denn die hat neuerdings die abgefahrene Idee, dass der Geist des toten Ludwig Rossbauer in Thaddäus gefahren sein könnte. Manchmal ist Oma Anni ganz froh, wenn sie neben ihren Tarotkarten und dem gelegentlich Schnäpschen eine von Klaras speziellen Zigaretten erwischt. Und ein Stein ...

programme.title: Kaffee oder Tee
programme.desc: Kaffee oder Tee - Das tägliche Service-Magazin bietet praktische Tipps und Informationen rund um die Themen Heim und Garten, Gesundheit, Küche und Haushalt. Experten geben hilfreiche Ratschläge für den Alltag und vermitteln Wissenswertes zu zahlreichen Lebensbereichen. Die Zuschauer können sich aktiv an der Sendung beteiligen, ihre Meinung zu aktuellen Themen äußern und mit Studiogästen ins Gespräch kommen. Darüber hinaus lädt ein Quiz zum Mitraten ein. So verbindet die Sendung Information, Unterhaltung und den direkten Austausch mit dem Publikum.

programme.title: aktueller bericht
programme.desc: Aktueller Bericht - Der "aktuelle bericht" - das sind die regionalen Tagesthemen im SR Fernsehen. programme.desc: Modellbahnzauber - Was 1991 als einfacher Pausenfüller begann, entwickelte sich schnell zu einer der beliebtesten Eisenbahnreihen im deutschen Fernsehen. Aus dem ursprünglichen Lückenfüller wurde eine feste Mission: die Welt der Eisenbahn in all ihren Facetten zu zeigen - von historischen Strecken und legendären Lokomotiven bis hin zu außergewöhnlichen Bahnreisen rund um den Globus. programme.desc: durch die Algarve - / arte Mit der Bahn durch die Algarve. Abseits der bekannten Traumstrände liegt das größte natürliche Riff Portugals. Aus dem traditionellen Rohstoff Kork werden Taschen und Schuhe produziert. Überall spielt Wind eine Rolle. Von Vila Real des Santo António an der spanischen Grenze geht es über Faro und Tunes bis nach Lagos im Westen. In der Algarve fahren mehr als 60 Jahre alte Dieseltriebwagen der portugiesischen Staatsbahn CP, die andernorts längst ausrangiert worden sind. Einerseits verbreiten sie Nostalgie, andererseits stellen sie eine Herausforderung für die Lokführer:innen dar, die die Fahrzeuge unterwegs auch schon mal notdürftig reparieren müssen. programme.title: Eisenbahn-Romantik
programme.desc: Argentinien - / SWR/SR Fernsehen El Tren a las nubes - "der Zug in die Wolken" bringt seine Passagier:innen in die überwältigende Landschaft der argentinischen Puna. Die 16-stündigen Reise beginnt in der Provinzhauptstadt Salta auf 1600 Meter Höhe und führt hinauf in die Andenkordilleren. Höhepunkt der Bahnfahrt ist der Umkehrpunkt hinter dem Viadukt Polvorilla auf 4200 Meter Höhe. Der Ramal C 14, so wird in Argentinien die Strecke genannt, zählt zu den höchsten, eindrucksvollsten Schienenwegen der Welt. Eröffnet wurde er 1948 als Güter- und Personenzugstrecke bis an die Grenze zu Chile, wo er auf dortiger Seite bis an die Küstenstadt Antofagasta weitergeführt wurde. Sporadisch fahren hier noch Güterzüge.

programme.desc: Quarks - Heute: Starkes Herz - wie wir uns schützen können Ein plötzlicher Herzstillstand kann viele Ursachen haben. Wie können wir vorbeugen und unser Herz besser schützen? Können uns moderne Uhren mit Gesundheitsfunktionen dabei helfen? programme.title: Eisenbahn-Romantik
programme.desc: Modellbahnzauber - Was 1991 als einfacher Pausenfüller begann, entwickelte sich schnell zu einer der beliebtesten Eisenbahnreihen im deutschen Fernsehen. Mit ihren ruhigen, eindrucksvollen Bildern und der zeitlosen Faszination der Bahn begeistert "Eisenbahn-Romantik" seit Jahrzehnten ein treues Publikum. Aus dem ursprünglichen Lückenfüller wurde eine feste Mission: die Welt der Eisenbahn in all ihren Facetten zu zeigen - von historischen Strecken und legendären Lokomotiven bis hin zu außergewöhnlichen Bahnreisen rund um den Globus. Damit macht die Reihe die Vielfalt und Bedeutung der Eisenbahn für Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer erlebbar.

programme.title: Eisenbahn-Romantik
programme.desc: durch die Algarve - / arte Mit der Bahn durch die Algarve. Abseits der bekannten Traumstrände liegt das größte natürliche Riff Portugals. Aus dem traditionellen Rohstoff Kork werden Taschen und Schuhe produziert. Überall spielt Wind eine Rolle. Von Vila Real des Santo António an der spanischen Grenze geht es über Faro und Tunes bis nach Lagos im Westen. In der Algarve fahren mehr als 60 Jahre alte Dieseltriebwagen der portugiesischen Staatsbahn CP, die andernorts längst ausrangiert worden sind. Einerseits verbreiten sie Nostalgie, andererseits stellen sie eine Herausforderung für die Lokführer:innen dar, die die Fahrzeuge unterwegs auch schon mal notdürftig reparieren müssen. Mindestens drei Stunden ...

programme.title: Eisenbahn-Romantik
programme.desc: Argentinien - / SWR/SR Fernsehen El Tren a las nubes - "der Zug in die Wolken" bringt seine Passagier:innen in die überwältigende Landschaft der argentinischen Puna. Die 16-stündigen Reise beginnt in der Provinzhauptstadt Salta auf 1600 Meter Höhe und führt hinauf in die Andenkordilleren. Höhepunkt der Bahnfahrt ist der Umkehrpunkt hinter dem Viadukt Polvorilla auf 4200 Meter Höhe. Der Ramal C 14, so wird in Argentinien die Strecke genannt, zählt zu den höchsten, eindrucksvollsten Schienenwegen der Welt. Eröffnet wurde er 1948 als Güter- und Personenzugstrecke bis an die Grenze zu Chile, wo er auf dortiger Seite bis an die Küstenstadt Antofagasta weitergeführt wurde. Sporadisch fahren hier noch Güterzüge.

programme.desc: Quarks - Heute: Starkes Herz - wie wir uns schützen können Ein plötzlicher Herzstillstand kann viele Ursachen haben. Oft steckt ein Herzinfarkt dahinter - immer noch eine der häufigsten Todesursachen in Deutschland. Aber die Wissenschaft kennt heute die wichtigsten Risikofaktoren. Wie können wir vorbeugen und unser Herz besser schützen? Können uns moderne Uhren mit Gesundheitsfunktionen dabei helfen? Nach erfolgreicher Krebsbehandlung mit OP, Bestrahlung und Antihormontherapie fürchtet sie, wieder zuzunehmen. Erst eine Magen-OP brachte ihr 50 Kilo Gewichtsverlust. Silvana isst zu unregelmäßig, zu viel Süßes und zu wenig sättigende Nährstoffe auf. Das befeuert Heißhunger. Sie soll ballaststoffreich essen, feste Mahlzeiten, weniger Zucker und mehr Gemüse, Hülsenfrüchte und Vollkornprodukte. Frank D. (48) kämpft mit massiven Verdauungsproblemen. programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Chip y los átomos entran en una cueva llena de pinturas en las paredes. Una puerta bloquea el paso a la cueva en un lugar donde se apilan células de elementos químicos y un horno. Siguiendo las indicaciones de las pinturas y con la ayuda del libro de química de Chip, descubre que debe mezclar y fusionar varios elementos para crear unos zapatos de vidrio con los que pueda caminar sobre un suelo lleno de ácido, de modo que la puerta se levante y pueda seguir el camino. Cuando las antimaterias intentan seguirlo, mientras mezclan productos químicos, estos les aplastan la nariz.

programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Un transporte cargado de nitratos se dirige a la Torre Negra para que el Dr. No prepare explosivos. Así, con la ayuda de átomos de bromo prisioneros, logra destruir el transporte y su peligrosa carga.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Mark and Mallory continue to struggle with communication and one major mistake jeopardizes their chances to keep racing.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams race through the Malaysian jungle where the roaring rapids crush their spirits and their homemade rafts. Plus, after being struck by taxi deja vu, one team fights to stay in the running.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: One racer pours blood and tears into an exhausting Roadblock and another racer suffers a meltdown during an extremely difficult Detour.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Race continues in Sri Lanka where teams struggle to get a bite when fishing for their next clue.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The teams are in Sri Lanka, where an exhausting Roadblock drains the racers of all their strength. Also, an epic race through the countryside ends with a footrace to the Pit Stop.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams race to Rome, Italy, where Racers and Roman gladiators square off in a medieval Detour. Plus, three teams strike a deal in order to try to avoid elimination.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The competition gets fierce as the remaining six teams face a double U-Turn, and the Cowboys contemplate a major decision.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: With the final finish line getting closer, tension between two teams rises. Meanwhile, three teams make a final three alliance in hopes of making it to the final leg.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Racers are in Spain where another double U-turn threatens the accidental alliance. Meanwhile, one team suffers a potentially game-changing injury.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The final four teams are in Liverpool, England, where they experience a once-in-a-lifetime shoot-out at the historic Anfield Stadium, home of the Liverpool FC.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: With the $1 million prize on the line, the final teams race through Las Vegas, where the world's greatest illusionist, David Copperfield, designs a final challenge that requires the remaining teams to master the art of illusion.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Eleven teams take off from Los Angeles, California on race around the world, starting with a stop in Valparaiso, Chile, where a high-wire walk Roadblock tests the mettle of several racers.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: When The Cow Kicked Me In The Head (Chile)

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்

programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.

நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

मस्करी
மஸ்கரி

programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்

programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle
programme.desc: C'est la fête chez les Tortues Ninja, mais malheureusement, ça ne va pas durer longtemps ! Les tortues ont répandu accidentellement une cargaison de tubes de mutagène au-dessus de la ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?
programme.desc: Les tortues parcourent la ville à la recherche des tubes de mutagène grâce au détecteur de fluides de Donnie. Karai repère leur manège et décide de leur tendre un piège...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants
programme.desc: Tandis qu'elles parcourent la ville à la recherche de tubes de mutagène, les tortues tombent sur un sans-abri au comportement étrange. Il est aux prises avec un écureuil très agressif, qui finit par se faufiler dans son estomac...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne
programme.desc: Pendant que ses frères regardent un dessin animé débile sur une vieille cassette vidéo, Donatello se confie à Timothy, transformé en mutant et conservé dans un tube dans son labo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey
programme.desc: Un beau matin, Mikey se réveille avec des boutons sur tout le corps, ou presque. Pris de panique, il va voir ses frères qui tentent de le rassurer. En retour, il avoue avoir saupoudré un dérivé de mutagène sur sa peau pour devenir plus cool...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil
programme.desc: Shredder a eu vent du comportement de Karaï durant son absence et lui ordonne de ne plus s'allier aux Krangs. Mais ces derniers ont fabriqué le successeur des Foot-bots, et Karaï veut absolument se le procurer afin d'éliminer April...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Slash la tortue
programme.desc: Raphael s'agace. Il n'en peut plus d'avoir des frères qui passent leur temps à plaisanter et à jouer, ou à faire des gaffes. Cette fois, l'une des expériences de Donnie tourne mal, et Spike manque d'y laisser sa carapace...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La conspiration des Krangs
programme.desc: Pendant leur entraînement quotidien, les tortues et April se sentent observées. Elles poursuivent l'espion jusqu'à sa cachette, afin de le démasquer. Il s'agit d'un dénommé Kurtzman, journaliste de son métier, qui enquête sur la conspiration des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au fond des bois
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La chasse au Big Foot
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Secrets enfouis
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'attaque des Grenouilles-Mutantes
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mauvais rêves
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fou du volant
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Metalhead unter Verdacht

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Von Ratten und Menschen
programme.desc: Als der Rattenkönig zurückkehrt, muss Splinter sein Schuldgefühl überwinden, genauso wie seine Furcht davor, dass der Rattenkönig seine Gedanken kontrolliert, um seinen Feind endgültig zu besiegen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Wurmattacke! - Teil 1
programme.desc: Wegen Shredders neuem Killer, muss Leo sich entscheiden, ob er das Leben seiner Brüder riskiert, oder Splinter um Hilfe bittet. Und Donnie muss sich mit Casey zusammenraufen, um eine neue Kraang-Verschwörung aufzudecken.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Wurmattacke! - Teil 2
programme.desc: Wegen Shredders neuem Killer, muss Leo sich entscheiden, ob er das Leben seiner Brüder riskiert, oder Splinter um Hilfe bittet. Und Donnie muss sich mit Casey zusammenraufen, um eine neue Kraang-Verschwörung aufzudecken.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Labyrinth der Mutanten
programme.desc: Die Turtles entspannen sich bei einem Fantasy-Rollenspiel. Doch als das Spiel echt wird, müssen sie zwischen Fantasie und Realität unterscheiden.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die einsame Verwandlung des Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: Die einsame Verwandlung des Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Die Turtles haben ein schlechtes Gewissen, weil sie Aprils Vater in eine mutierte Fledermaus verwandelt haben. Sie entwickeln ein Retro-Mutagen, um ihm zu helfen. Leider wird alles noch schlimmer, als Stockman droht, April in einen Mutanten zu verwandeln.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Der Molchinator
programme.desc: Raph ist sich nicht sicher, ob Casey das Zeug hat, der großen Gefahr durch die Mutanten zu begegnen, als sie wieder auf Slash treffen und entdecken, dass auch er einen Partner hat: den MOLCHINATOR!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tiger Claws Rache
programme.desc: Tiger Claw kommt zurück und will die Turtles um jeden Preis vernichten.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Pizzaface
programme.desc: Mikey entdeckt, dass ein neuer Mutant Menschen mit lebenden Pizzen angreift und gefangen nimmt. Aber er schafft es nicht, die anderen davon zu überzeugen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Der legendäre Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Leo macht sich Sorgen um Karai und versucht die anderen dazu zu bringen, sie zu retten. Gleichzeitig stiehlt ein Meisterdieb Shredders Helm, der daraufhin in die Hände der ahnungslosen Turtles fällt.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Plan 10
programme.desc: Hitzkopf Raph brockt sich durch seine unüberlegte Art ordentlich Ärger ein. Er beschädigt aus Versehen eine Maschine und findet sich im Körper eines Kraang wieder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Rache ist mein
programme.desc: Leo hintergeht Splinter, um Karai zu retten. Ihr Wunsch nach Rache an Shredder hat für alle schlimme Konsequenzen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Der Geist von Chinatown
programme.desc: Donnie ist eifersüchtig auf das Verhältnis zwischen April und Casey. Dann wird April von einem bösen Geist entführt, der ihre Kräfte aufzehren möchte.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Auf in die Dimension X !
programme.desc: Zuhause baut Mikey ständig nur Mist. Doch als sich die Turtles in der grotesken Dimension X wiederfinden, ist er der Einzige, der versteht, wie dort alles funktioniert.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Invasion Teil 1
programme.desc: Leo und Donnie sind sich uneinig, wie die Invasion der Kraang aufzuhalten ist. Als Leo einen fatalen Fehler begeht und vom Team getrennt wird, muss Donnie die Führungsrolle übernehmen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Invasion Teil 2
programme.desc: Leo und Donnie sind sich uneinig, wie die Invasion der Kraang aufzuhalten ist. Als Leo einen fatalen Fehler begeht und vom Team abgetrennt wird, muss Donnie die Führungsrolle übernehmen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Ein Dino kommt selten allein...
programme.desc: Als Raphael in der Kanalisation auf den Dino-Alien Zog trifft, dessen Mission die Zerstörung der Kraang ist, scheinen die Turtles einen neuen Verbündeten gefunden zu haben. Doch der Schein trügt.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tief im Wald
programme.desc: Das Team befürchtet, dass Leo vielleicht nicht gesund wird, und dann kommt es sogar noch schlimmer: Ein neuer Mutant bringt Raph in seine Gewalt!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Der Bigfoot-Jäger
programme.desc: Die Turtles entdecken im Wald einen Bigfoot. Donnie freundet sich mit ihm an und besteht darauf, dass sie ihn vor einem Jäger schützen, der hinter ihm her ist.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Verborgene Geheimnisse
programme.desc: In dem Kraang-Schiff, das unter Aprils Haus begraben liegt, findet das Team Aprils Mutter! Aber schon bald fragen sich alle außer April: Ist sie wirklich die Mutter, die sie zu sein scheint?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Das große Quaken
programme.desc: Ein genervter Mikey läuft weg und freundet sich im Wald mit einem Mutanten-Frosch an, dessen Gang plant, die Welt der Menschen anzugreifen, was Mickey natürlich verhindern will.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Alles nur geträumt…
programme.desc: Wesen, die sich durch Träume ernähren, fangen die Turtles in ihren eigenen Träumen, während April und Casey einen Weg finden müssen, ihre Freunde zu wecken.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Ein teuflisches Rennen
programme.desc: Casey und Donnie werden beim Bau von Caseys neuem Hot Rod Freunde, als sie sich dem Speed Dämon, einem Hot Rod Mutanten, stellen müssen, der die Straßen terrorisiert.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Augen der Chimäre
programme.desc: Als Casey, Raph, Mikey und Donnie von einem neuen Mutanten gefangengenommen werden, müssen April und Leo ihre Schwächen überwinden, um sie zu retten.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Reise ins Ich
programme.desc: Leo führt mit den Turtles im Wald ein Ninja-Ritual durch, bei dem sie ihre Schwächen überwinden und sich ihren größten Feinden stellen müssen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Rückkehr nach New York
programme.desc: Auf der Suche nach Splinter stellen die Turtles bei ihrer Rückkehr nach New York fest, dass es in der Stadt von Kraang nur so wimmelt.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Schlangenjagd
programme.desc: Als die Turtles Karai suchen, schlagen sie sich nicht nur mit Kraangdroiden herum, sondern auch mit Zeck und Steranko, die aus eigenen Motiven Jagd auf Karai machen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Das Schwein und das Nashorn
programme.desc: Donnie stellt neues Retro-Mutagen in der Hoffnung her, Karai retten zu können, aber dann stoßen die Turtles auf Shredders neue, brutale Gehilfen: Bebop und Rocksteady!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Schlacht um New York - Teil 1
programme.desc: Leo traut Slash nicht über den Weg, der als Anführer eines neuen Teams auftaucht, das sich "Mighty Mutanimals" nennt.

programme.desc: ラジオカナダがお届けするニュース。

programme.title: （字）まばゆい太陽（訳題） UN SI GRAND SOLEIL
programme.desc: モンペリエを舞台に、バスティード、エストレラ、サラマ、レヴィらを取り巻く家族の生活は刻々と変化していた。ロマンスあり事件あり、それぞれの運命が交錯する。

programme.title: アップサイクルに挑戦 BON DEBARRAS
programme.desc: 捨てられた物に新たな命を吹き込む！リサイクルセンターのスタッフたちとスイスの職人14名が協力し、不要品をアップサイクルしていく。

programme.title: （字）地上の輝き LE CLAIR DE TERRE
programme.desc: 21歳のピエールは、父と一緒にパリを離れ、自分たちのルーツであるチュニジアへ向かう。母が亡くなったこの地で、彼は幼少期の思い出と向き合う。

programme.title: （字）犯罪はすぐそばに（訳題） LE CRIME LUI VA SI BIEN
programme.desc: そっくりさん？ ジョニー・アリディのそっくりさんがアメ車の運転席で遺体で発見される。この業界の問題や対立関係を解明すべく、調査に取り掛かるのだが。

programme.title: フランス海外県ニュース OUTREMER.L'INFO
programme.desc: フランス海外県の最新ニュースをお届けする。

programme.title: グランド・カクタス LE GRAND CACTUS
programme.desc: 毒気のあるユーモア満載！司会のアドリアンとジェロームが、ベルギー国内外のニュースを、パロディやフェイクニュース、偽の生放送やインタビューで、徹底的に笑わせる。

programme.title: （字）21世紀 フランス流行通信 TENDANCE XXI
programme.desc: モードやデザイン、ビューティー、ガストロノミーなど、様々な分野のフランス流クリエーションを発信する番組。バイタリティーあふれる流行最先端の世界へ誘います。

programme.title: フランス２ニュース LE JOURNAL DE FRANCE 2

programme.title: （字）冤罪の行方〜イノセンス・プロジェクト（訳題） FICTION
programme.desc: ステラ・ロニエールは、冤罪救済団体イノセンス・プロジェクトの研修生。殺人罪で服役中のアンダーソンを担当することになったステラは、事件の真相を追い求めていく。

programme.title: （字）豊かな暮らし LA BELLE VIE

programme.title: （字）友だちと行く 新しい旅のかたち DOCUMENTAIRE

programme.desc: A meeting with artisans reinventing coffee and chocolate, blending tradition, creativity and boldness, in a subtle dialogue of flavors. Yadh Elyes, master roaster in Paris' 6th arrondissement, offers exceptional coffees. Richard Orlinski is invited to taste rare beans from Tanzania and Panama. Chocolatier Clement Niel has settled in Bangkok, where he fuses expertise and local flavors. Inspired by the Khlong Toei market, he creates a spicy chocolate, the result of meticulous ingredient research, and brightly colored chocolate candies. Clement collaborates with Leo, a local producer, to select the ideal Thai cocoa beans, combining floral notes and cocoa intensity.

programme.title: д/с Древние пришельцы (Фактор Эйнштейна)
programme.desc: Мог ли гений Альберта Эйнштейна быть связанным с иными мирами? Эксперты внимательно изучают не только его биографию, но и биографии Галилея, Архимеда и Аристотеля. programme.title: д/с Необъяснимое (Тайны американских памятников)
programme.desc: Американские памятники поражают своими масштабными замыслами и колоссальными размерами и представляют собой настоящие чудеса инженерной мысли. История их создания известна всем, но у каждого выдающегося памятника есть и другая, тайная история. Вед.: Уильям Шетнер. США

programme.title: д/с Величайшие клады истории (Подводное золото)
programme.desc: Джон Чаттерон, друг Рика и Марти и первоклассный специалист по погружениям на затонувшие суда, отправляется на поиски испанского корабля, затонувшего у побережья Флориды. Гари Дрейтон рассказывает о своей самой ценной находке. Вед.: Рик Лагина, Марти Лагина, Мэтью Блейк. США

programme.title: д/с Древние пришельцы (Пришельцы и снежный человек)

programme.desc: В 1980 году троих молодых британских солдат направили в леса, чтобы понять происхождение странного свечения. Позже с них взяли пожизненную подписку о неразглашении. Почему подобные встречи с НЛО продолжают скрывать? Реж.: Кевин Барнс, Дэвид Сильвер. США, 2009, фантастика, фэнтези, документалка, история

programme.title: д/с Древние открытия. 7 с.
programme.desc: Инженеры, историки и археологи пытаются разгадать загадки троянской войны, изучая место древних сражений в поисках новых подсказок и доказательств. Реж.: Стюарт Кларк, Али МакГрат, Бен Моул. В ролях: Том Пэйн, Фил Краули, Шон Баррет, Кристофер Келли. США, Великобритания, Австралия, 2003-2008, документалка, история

programme.title: Охотники за потерянными реликвиями (Первый крестовый поход)
programme.desc: Карл и Гамильтон исследуют меч крестоносца и рыцарский шлем, которым более 900 лет. Чуть позже они едут в Венецию, чтобы больше узнать об истории этого города, в частности, почему венецианцы избрали своим покровителем святого Марка

programme.title: д/с Исчезнувшие на Аляске (Пропавшие в вихре)
programme.desc: В 1950 году в Аляскинском Бермудском треугольнике пропал военный транспортный самолет с 44 людьми на борту. Что стало причиной исчезновения? Плохая погода или некая зловещая сила, не поддающаяся объяснению? Вед.: Кен Герхард. США

programme.title: д/с Древние пришельцы. 3 с.
programme.desc: Возможно, наши далекие предки знали, как добывать электричество за тысячи лет до нас? Джорджио Цукалос считает, что некоторые известные исторические руины – это забытые электростанции, связанные с инопланетными пришельцами. Реж.: Кевин Барнс, Дэвид Сильвер. В ролях: Роберт Клотуорти, Гиоргио Цукалос, Дэвид Чайлдресс, Филип Коппенс, Эрих фон Дэникен, Джонатан Янг, Джейсон Мартелл, Джордж Нури, Майкл Деннин, Уильям Дж. Бирнс. США, 2009, фантастика, фэнтези, документалка, история

programme.title: д/с Хит-парад древности: Первая десятка (Диктаторы)
programme.desc: Жадность, убийства и геноцид: такие люди, как Юлий Цезарь, Чингисхан, Аттила и Клеопатра не остановились ни перед чем, чтобы вписать свое имя в историю. Кто из этих тиранов займет первое место в рейтинге диктаторов древнего мира? Реж.: Стюарт Кларк. Вед.: Майкл Браун. США

programme.title: д/с Эволюция. Битва за жизнь (Кожа)
programme.desc: Внешний облик животных определяет их способности к выживанию. Размер и форма имеют значение, и даже малейшие изменения этих параметров существенно влияют на решение вопроса жизни и смерти. США

programme.title: д/с Битвы до нашей эры (Моисей: Исход)
programme.desc: Проявив недюжинные стратегические способности, Моисей увел свой народ из Египта и заманил армию египтян в смертельную водяную ловушку. Небольшая армия греков разбила армию персов благодаря несгибаемой силе духа. Реж.: Дэвид Падруш. В ролях: Брайан Макгоун, Кэззи Луис Серегино, Брэд Уилкокс, Брайан Дэннер, Пол Джейкобсон, Дастин Зани, Дэвид Джон Уилсон, Дрю Тейлор, Рафаэль Джордан, Джошуа Брэдли. programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh and Jason are escorting prisoners to Leavenworth prison when a stranger begins following along behind.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is summoned for help when the Pinto bank is robbed.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh expects a bounty for bringing in Daniel Trenner but his prisoner is stolen by the sheriff. Ex-army personnel want to stage an illegal trial accusing their former lieutenant of dereliction of duty

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is hired by a woman to sober up Harry, a drunk who is also Josh's friend. She learned his wealthy brother who Harry hasn't seen in years is coming to visit so she wants Harry to be presentable.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh and the beautiful prisoner he is transporting are on a three day trip while her partner is still on the loose. For once Josh may not follow through on obeying the law as they fall in love.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is on his way to River City to transport three convicts there to be hanged. The dangerous prisoners escape and appoint themselves the law, after the town is hit by a tornado, killing the sheriff.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A journalist accompanies Josh on his manhunt to get an exclusive story on a bounty hunter. Josh agrees to let him join him in the hunt for Jack Torrance but finds they have different methods.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh feels compelled to repay a debt to an old friend who's in jail and may hang. However, the friend escapes, forcing Josh to go on the hunt for him until it appears he died when he went over a cliff

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh brings in outlaw Carlos Domingo, but he has to be released when the witness against him is killed. Josh concocts a surprise witness to testify against the notorious killer - his own mother.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh is sent for by the desperate men of Coronado. He is hired to convince the women of the town to come back to their men when they leave demanding that all towns men give up their guns for good.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh brings in a man wanted for robbery but loses his reward. A well meaning doctor pays an innocent man to take the blame for his son, but the son sets out to kill the man to make sure he never tells

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh arrives in a town for rest just as the local bank has been robbed. A traveling medicine man knows the whereabouts of the suspect and wants Josh to help because he thinks the suspect is innocent.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A widow wants to hire/propose to Josh so she doesn't lose custody of her son. Josh served under her husband in the war. His mother now is trying to steal her grandson to take over the family fortune.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A woman asks Josh, an old friend, to help find her husband Frank - a bounty hunter out to settle a score. He wants to catch a young outlaw who shot him in the leg.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: When Randall has a sheriff bed a prisoner, the man's gang kidnaps the sheriff and two others and threatens to kill one per day until the man is freed.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: In Mexico, Josh is hired to protect a man and his pregnant wife from his the villagers who are angered when he refuses the town healing woman or "witch" from being present when his wife gives birth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.
